t: The Milwaukee Hex Shank Multi-Material Drill Bit offers versatile drilling for trade professionals across various construction materials. This 5.5mm drill bit is ideal for electricians, plumbers, and general builders tackling diverse tasks on site, from installing fixtures to routing cables. Featuring a robust tungsten carbide tip, it effortlessly penetrates concrete, brick, roof tiles, wood, metal, and PVC. Its impact-rated design ensures secure driving with impact drivers and compatibility with standard 3-jaw chuck machines, providing reliable performance. The hardened steel alloy construction and white flute offer enhanced durability and easy identification for demanding applications.
b: Suitable for Wide Range of Building Materials, Ceramics & Tiles, Wood, Plastic, Thin Sheet Metals & Aluminium
